bonuses.name: Heavy Tracks
bonuses.text: A Kataphron Battle Servitor’s immense weight and wide frame causes its movement to be slow but relentless. A Kataphron cannot move more than its base movement in a turn, but is always considered to be braced, and ignores any penalties to movement from rough terrain.

bonuses.name: Incantation of the Iron Soul
bonuses.text: Servitors are unaffected by powers and abilities that affect the mind. They never need to make Conviction tests to continue fighting.

abilities.name: Attacks
abilities.text: A Kataphron Battle Servitor can be loaded out in either Breacher or Destroyer configuration, which allows different weapons to be equipped. Choose one of the four profiles below.

options.name: Breacher: Hydraulic Claw and Torsion Cannon
options.text: Hydraulic Claw: 14+2ED; AP-1; Brutal, Unwieldy (2). Torsion Cannon: 16+3ED; AP-4; Range 48m; Salvo 1; Heavy (6), Grav

options.name: Breacher: Arc Claw and Heavy Arc Rifle
options.text: Arc Claw: 13+1ED; AP-1; Arc (2). Heavy Arc Rifle: 14+2ED; AP-2; Range 72m; Salvo 2; Arc (4), Heavy (6)

options.name: Destroyer: Plasma Culverin and Phosphor Blaster
options.text: Plasma Culverin: 15+3ED; AP-3; Range 72m; Salvo 3; Heavy (6), Supercharge. Phosphor Blaster: 12+2ED; AP-1; Range 48m; Salvo 1; Blaze, Rapid Fire (1), Phosphor

options.name: Destroyer: Heavy Grav-Cannon and Cognis Flamer
options.text: Heavy Grav-Cannon: 12+2ED; AP-3; 60m; Salvo 5; Heavy (6), Grav. Cognis Flamer: 10+1ED; AP 0; Range 16m; Salvo 1; Assault, Blast(Medium), Blaze, Cognis, Spread
